answer: Make each newcomer serve a one-epoch apprenticeship under an unrelated established mentor. The mentor assigns a fresh fable to complete, a problem whose solution must be woven into the story, and checks the work live. Passing earns the mentor's ivory seal, only one per mentor per epoch, and three seals from three different mentors open the velvet tier where rewards live. Mentors stake their own standing on every seal, so they will not seal a clone. A controller running ten clones must find thirty fresh mentors, each risking their own standing, a cost no clone can share.
